Have you ever felt that deep, almost indescribable longing to truly belong? That pull toward the places and people who shaped your earliest memories—no matter how far away they might be now?
Together, we’re about to step into a remarkable journey that brings these feelings to life. In the pages of A Long Way Home, Saroo Brierley invites us to walk beside him, from the confusion and heartbreak of being lost as a child in India, to the unfamiliar embrace of a new family in Australia.
This isn’t just a story about being lost and found. It’s a heartfelt exploration of identity, of holding onto hope, and the unbreakable bond of family—even when those connections are stretched across continents and years.
As we follow Saroo’s search for his origins, we’ll feel the highs and lows: the moments of despair, the flashes of hope, and the sheer determination it takes to bridge two very different worlds. What makes his journey even more extraordinary is the way technology—something many of us use every day—becomes a lifeline, shining a light onto lost memories and opening doors to the past.
So, as we begin this adventure together, let’s be curious. Let’s discover how love, memory, and the longing for connection can defy distance and time. By the end, you might find yourself reflecting on what it truly means to come home—and how the search for belonging can change us in ways we never expected.
